quest.title: Date's Challenge
quest.description: You decide to take on this labyrinth challenge.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.text: Oh ho, are you here to try my latest, greatest work, too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are you, Enkanomiya's celebrity chef?

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: The name's Date. They used to call me Daedalus, son of Eurydates. I'm a labyrinth artisan! The puzzle you just went through is my work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so you're the guy who had fun stumping us, huh? Alright! Bye!

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Hey, wait, wait a moment! I'm not just some kid doodling on pieces of paper. I'm no mere labyrinth artisan either — I'm the second-best architect in the history of Byakuyakoku!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And who's number one?

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Why, Aberaku no Mikoto, of course, bless his heart! If the Dainichi Mikoshi were to be second place, no other building could take first place.

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: The fact that you've met me means that you've cleared my first "Neopathos"-style labyrinth.

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: How did you find it? Any interest in trying my other "Heterodoxa"-style labyrinth? It's completely different from one made only from walls.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No need. We've sampled your work enough as-is.

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Oh, come on now. This masterpiece was a result of abundant space, time, and funds!

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: A significant portion of us have already gone to live on Watatsumi Island up there on the surface, so there's plenty of real estate around here.

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: And that's why I borrowed "Hydrological Studies in Byakuyakoku." I meant to study the principles of load-bearing, the maximization of underground spaces, the avoidance of water leakage, and even some principles of geomancy!

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Well, and sorry, Ema, but I... might have left the book in the labyrinth's treasure vault...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry, what were you muttering about?

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Nothing! I mean to cordially invite you to challenge my grand masterpiece!

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Whatever the case may be, take this key. It can be used to open the puzzles.

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: If you are successful, you can even obtain a medal of recognition that I made myself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's not a very rare prize.

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: I have also hidden my treasures in the vault ahead. If you obtain two medals, you can open the treasury!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... is that how it is? Well, we'll give it a try if we have time, then.

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Wonderful! I look forward to your feedback.

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Ah, yes! Since you've conquered the first labyrinth, here's your first medal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, okay...

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: So, any comments?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How should we put it? It felt like...

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Felt like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It felt like it lacked a little boom-shaka-laka.

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Boom-shaka-laka? What's that?

talks.objective: Obtain Date's other Medal of Recognition

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Did you clear the labyrinth over there as well? Good, very good. Very impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, okay...

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: What did you think of it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What we think? Well...

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Hehe, it was super intricate and super awesome, wasn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh... Hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: What do you mean, "hehe"!?

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: *cough* Regardless, since you now have both medals of recognition, the path to the secret chamber should now be open.

dialogues.speaker: Date
dialogues.text: Place the medals in there, and you should be able to open the treasury gate.

talks.objective: Open Date's secret room and obtain the treasure
